limitations: This is a bounded completed-run DATA review, not a new execution, production/runtime/profile/source adoption grant or universal performance claim.

Each arm/case/comparison has three fresh process setups and seven correlated samples per process. Process medians and paired ratios are retained without sample pooling, trimming, significance testing or control subtraction. Fresh processes do not imply iid workstation timing conditions.

All complete returned compact strings, lengths/FNV aggregates, counters and state were reviewed. Per-operation output byte arrays were not retained in timing; separate untimed full-byte correctness remains an independent prerequisite.

Output FNV consumption and guest wire conversion are inside measured intervals; six separately timed N1 controls per process are not equivalent codec-only overhead to subtract. Empty logical-byte cases have null byte throughput.

Provider comparisons use the same engine but different codec implementations/options and sometimes encoded sizes. The unused-profile comparison uses byte-identical fflate code with distinct ON/OFF engines. These comparisons remain separate.

Reported RSS includes the whole Node process, authentication/parser/loader/runtime/evidence overhead and allocator history. It is not guest heap/capacity, codec-only allocation, native GC count or erasure evidence. The load interval is combined hashes/binding/ESM-TLA initialization/instantiation/post-load hashes, not isolated compile/instantiate or physical cold startup.

Task-agent quiet coordination and declared boundaries were verified; unrelated desktop/system activity was explicitly uncontrolled. Monotonic clock domains were not interchanged. Enclosing Python controller zero is a Root-recorded observation; the Node parent and worker terminals were independently decoded.

The original Root observer failure was a read-only sample/control classification error and remains preserved. No workload/source/output was changed or repeated. Original B5 pilot source and actual calibration remain B5, not relabelled as V5.
